description: This script is a testing framework for verifying the behavior of 'git submodule summary' in various scenarios. It sets up a git environment, adds submodules, updates them, deinitializes and reinitializes submodules, and tests their summary outputs to ensure correctness.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, runs the provided commands as the test body.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with given content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the git commit timestamp to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.
